t: Din hanhagat sheliach tzibbur bey"ch berakot vedin aniyyat amen
s: Din hanhagat sheliach tzibbur bey"ch berakot vedin aniyyat amen ubo y"d seipim: leachar shessiyyemu hatztzibbur tepillatam — yachazor sheliach tzibbur hattepilla beqol ram, sheim yesh mi sheeno yodea lehitpallel — yishma kol hattepilla mehashsheliach tzibbur veyotze, abal habbaqi eno yotze yede chobato bitpillat sheliach tzibbur. Vaapillu mi sheeno baqi eno yotze ella betzibbur, dehaynu shet' yihyu shomein umekavvenim lebirkat hashsheliach tzibbur veyaanu amen acharayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"t:

Veeno yotze ella keshemmebin bilshon haqqodesh ella sheeno yodea lehitpallel, abal im eno mebin mah shehashsheliach tzibbur omer — eno yotze bishmia mehashsheliach tzibbur, ella tzarik lehitpallel leatzmo belashon shemmebin, ki ap baamira eno yotze ella im ken mebin (kemo shennitbaer besiman s"b), shehare kesheeno mebin eno mekavven apillu be"abot", umi shello kivven beabot — lo yatza yede chobato kemo shennitbaer besiman q"a (lepikak chayyab hu lilmod lehabin perush hattepilla ulepachot "birkat abot"). Vetzarik oto sheyyotze bitpillat sheliach tzibbur lekavven lekol mah sheomer sheliach tzibbur merosh ad sop. Veachar kak yipsa laachorayv g' pesiot (keadam shemmitpallel leatzmo, velo yapsiq velo yasiach ad leachar sheyyipsa) kederek sheeno mapsiq veeno sach keshemmitpallel hu beatzmo ad leachar sheyyipsa kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"b, shehare shemia zo ola lo bimqom tepilla (ella laanot dabar shebbiqdushsha lebad yakol lehapsiq qodem sheppasa kemo shennitbaer sham. Abal qodem siyyum shemiat y"ch apillu ledabar shebbiqdushsha eno mapsiq ella laanot "amen" achar birkot hashsheliach tzibbur, she"amen" hu biklal habberaka kemo sheyyitbaer veeno chashub hepseq battepilla, abal lo yomar "baruk hu ubaruk shemo", sheen omerim "baruk hu ubaruk shemo" ella kesheomedim bemaqom shemmuttar lehapsiq sham, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veken bekol maqom sheshshomea beraka umitkavven latzet yede chobato bishmiato, kegon qiddush vehabdala ubirkat happerot vehammitzvot — lo yaaneh "baruk hu ubaruk shemo", shehare shomea keoneh veasur lehapsiq beemtza habberaka. Veepshar sheapillu bediabad lo yatza yede chobato, kevan shemmapsiq ben Hashem lemalkut bedabar sheeno mittiqqun chakamim — hare zeh meshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim bibrakot. Vetzarik lehazhir larabbim shennikshalim bazeh):

Sheliach tzibbur shenniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shehitpalelu belachash vehu tzarik laabor lahem lipne hatteba lealtar — yored lipne hatteba umitpallel beqol ram latztzibbur, veen tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel belachash, laacherim motzi — leatzmo lo kol shekken. Veen bazeh mishshum "hammashmia qolo bitpillato hare zeh miqqetanne amana", kevan sheal yede haddechaq hu oseh ken. Veken im hu sheat haddechaq shei epshar lehitpallel belachash techilla, kegon sheyyare shemma yaabor zeman hattepilla velo yukal ligmor kol y"ch berakot shel chazarat hattepilla tok zeman hattepilla — yakol lehitpallel miyyad beqol ram vehatztzibbur mitpalelin immo milla bemilla belachash ad leachar "hael haqqadosh". Vetob sheyyihyeh echad lekol happachot sheyyaaneh "amen" achar birkat hashsheliach tzibbur, im yihyeh lo shehut lehitpallel achar kak o shehitpallel kebar:

Qahal shehitpalelu belachash vekullam beqiim battepilla — ap al pi ken yered sheliach tzibbur lipne hatteba veyachazor hattepilla beqol ram kede leqayyem taqqanat chakamim, shekkeshettiqqenu chakamim sheyyachazor sheliach tzibbur hattepilla — lo hitzriku lechappes bekol tepilla achar kol ish vaish shebbebet hakkeneset im yesh sham mi sheeno baqi im lav, ella tiqqenu sheyyihyeh sheliach tzibbur chozer hattepilla leolam, shemma yihyeh paam echad bebet hakkeneset mi sheeno baqi veyotziennu hashsheliach tzibbur yede chobato. Veken kol dabar hannitqan bishbil dabar acher, en inyano shello naaset hattaqqana hahi ad sheyyihyeh sham oto haddabar shennitqena bishbilo, raq inyano shennaaset hattaqqana hahi al kol panim, gezera shemma yihyeh sham oto haddabar shennitqena bishbilo (vaapillu im botla haggezera legamre — lo botla hattaqqana shennitqena beminyan chakamim ad sheyyemannu minyan acher lehattirah ap al pi shebbatel hattaam shebbiglalo tiqqenu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"r). Veod tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur lachazor hattepilla kede lomar qedushsha betzibbur:

Keshessiyyemu hatztzibbur lehitpallel y"ch veyesh yechidim shemmaarikim bitpillatam — en lishliach tzibbur lehamtin alehem apillu hayu chashube hair, mippene torach hatztzibbur. Veken im haya minyan bebet hakkeneset — en lehamtin al adam chashub o gadol sheadayin lo ba, mippene kebod tzibbur. Veakshav nahagu shehashsheliach tzibbur mamtin ad sheyyesayyem haab bet din et tepillato, lepi sherob haanashim mitpalelin bimrutza veim yechidim mitpalelim milla bemilla lo yukelu lomar qedushsha im hatztzibbur, laken mamtinim. Lepikak im en ab bet din bair — yamtinu al hammitpallel milla bemilla, abal keshemmaarik en lehamtin alayv. Umi shetztzarik lehaarik veyare sheyyitlotzetzu alayv — yakol lelek laachorayv beshaa shemmatchil hashsheliach tzibbur ap al pi sheadayin lo gamar tepillato, veyachazor limqomo veyigmor:

Kesheshsheliach tzibbur chozer hattepilla — yesh lekol haqqahal lishtoq ulekavven labberakot shemmebarek hashsheliach tzibbur velaanot amen. Veim en t' mekavvenim lebirkotayv — qarob lihyot birkotayv lebattala, ki chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur nitqena leomrah baasara, ukesheen t' mekavvenim lebirkotayv — nireh kibraka lebattala. Laken kol adam yaaseh atzmo keillu en t' zulato vikavven lebirkat hashsheliach tzibbur. Veyesh ligor baanashim shellomedim beet chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur o omerim tachanunim, vaapillu im mekavvenim lesop habberaka laanot amen karauy shello tihyeh "amen yetoma" kemo sheyyitbaer — lo yapeh hem osim (sheim en t' hamkavvenim litchillat habberakot — hare hashsheliach tzibbur omer techillat habberakot lebattala shello kemo shettiqqenu chakamim, shehare tiqqenu chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur kede lehotzi et sheeno baqi veeno motzio ella keshet' shomeim lo, veim en t' shomeim ella besop habberakot ap al pi shezzeh sheeno baqi shomea bekol habberakot — lo yatza yede chobato, kevan shettechillat habberakot lo shama ella beyachid veen hayyachid motzi et hayyachid battepilla, vehammitpallel sop habberakot belo techillatan — lo yatza yede chobato kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d, vekevan shettaqqanat chakamim hayeta sheyyishmeu t' lepachot gam techillat habberakot kede lehotzi et sheeno baqi — lo botla taqqanatam ap akshav shekkullam beqiim, kemo shennitbaer. Vekol adam yaaseh atzmo keillu en t' zulato, vikavven lekol beraka meroshah ad sopah) sheim hallomedim yipnu lallimmudim — amme haaretz yilmedu mehen shello lehaazin lehashsheliach tzibbur veyaasqu besicha betela, nimtzeu machatiim et harabbim:

Yesh omerim shekkol haam yaamdu keshechozer hashsheliach tzibbur hattepilla, kevan shemmekavvenim veshomeim hattepilla mehashsheliach tzibbur veshomea keoneh ukeillu mitpalelin beatzman (velaken niqreu hatteqiot shebbachazarat hashsheliach tzibbur berosh hashshana teqiot meummad, lepi shekkol haam omedim bachazarat hashsheliach tzibbur):

Al kol beraka sheadam shomea bekol maqom nohagin lomar "baruk hu ubaruk shemo", al shem hakkatub: "ki shem Hashem eqra habu godel leloqenu". Veod, apillu keshemmazkir tzaddiq basar vadam — tzarik leborko, shenneemar "zeker tzaddiq libraka". Umikkol maqom, kevan sheeno ella minhag velo mittiqqun chakamim — en mapsiqin leomro bekol maqom sheasur lehapsiq lidbar hareshut, apillu bemaqom shemmuttar lehapsiq laaniyyat amen kegon bipsuqe dezimra:

Veachar kol beraka uberaka yaaneh amen, ben otam sheyyatzeu yede tepilla ben otam shello yatzeu yede tepilla. Vehakkavvana sheyyekavven belibbo: emet hi habberaka shebberak hambarek vaani maamin bazeh, ki amen hu leshon haamanat debarim. Veamen sheachar sheelot ubaqqashot, kegon amen shebbaqqaddish vekayyotze bo — yekavven al heatid sheyyeamenu debarayv ubaqqashotayv shel zeh viquyyemu bimhera. Ubibrakot emtzaiyyot shel tepilla ubirkat "retzeh" ve"sim shalom", shechatimatan hi shebach vehodaa lishmo vegam yichul veqivvuy sheyyequyyam dabar zeh bimhera — tob lekavven gam ken beamen b' hainyanim, sheemet hu dabar zeh vesheyyeamenu debarayv (shel zeh) viquyyam dabar zeh bimhera:

Lo yasiach sichat chullin beshaa sheshsheliach tzibbur chozer hattepilla. Veim sach — hu chote vegadol avono minneso apillu yesh t' zulato, shekkol hammesiach bebet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur asuqin beshibcho shel maqom — mareh beatzmo sheen lo cheleq belohe yisrael. Vaapillu haoseq battora sheeno chote kol kak — lo yapeh hu oseh, kemo shennitbaer. Vilammed adam banayv haqqetannim vichannekem laanot amen. Umiyyad shehattinoq oneh amen — yesh lo cheleq laolam habba. Vetzarik sheyyechannekem laamod beema ubeyira. Veotan sheratzim veshabim bebet hakkeneset bischoq — mutab shello lahabiam kelal lebet hakkeneset:

Lo yaaneh amen chatupa, dehaynu keillu haale"p nequda bachata"p (qama"tz o qamatz chata"p, ella beqama"tz gadol). Veken shello yachtop vimaher laanot oto qodem sheyyesayyem hambarek. Veken lo yaaneh amen qetupa, dehaynu shemmachsir qeriat hannu"n sheeno motziah bappeh shettehe nikkeret. Veken lo yipsoq hatteba lishtayim. Velo yaaneh amen yetoma, dehaynu shello yamtin im haaniyyat haamen, ella miyyad shekkolta habberaka mippi hambarek yaaneh amen. Veim hashsheliach tzibbur maarik harbeh banniggun shel "veimru amen" — yomar miyyad amen, ki haarakat hanniggun harbeh hu hepseq. Veken im lo shama habberaka mippi hambarek, ap al pi sheyyodea ezo beraka hu mebarek, meachar shello shemaah im oneh acharayv amen — hare zeh amen yetoma. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu chayyab beotah beraka lebarek otah verotzeh latzet yede chobato baaniyyat amen achar hambarek otah, abal im eno chayyab bah sheeno rotzeh latzet yede chobato bazeh — rashshay laanot achar kol beraka ap al pi shello shemaah, veap al pi sheeno yodea ezeh beraka hi. Veyesh omerim sheim eno yodea ezo beraka — hare zeh amen yetoma, vaapillu eno mechuyyab bah — lo yaaneh achareha. Abal im yodea ezo beraka hi, ap al pi shello shemaah mippi hambarek — oneh achareha apillu im hu chayyab bah, veyotze yede chobato baaniyya zo. Vahalaka kishte hassebarot lehachamir, sheim hu chayyab beotah beraka verotzeh latzet bah yede chobato — tzarik sheyyishma otah mippi hambarek. Veim lav, ap sheyyodea ezeh beraka hi — hare zeh amen yetoma kassebara harishona. Veap im eno mechuyyab bah, im eno yodea ezo beraka hi — lo yaaneh achareha kassebara haacharona. Veyesh omerim sheapillu im eno mechuyyab lebarek otah veyodea ezo beraka hi, im habberaka nitqena lehotzi rabbim yede chobatan kegon chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur — lo yaaneh achareha ad sheyyishma otah keillu haya rotzeh latzet bah yede chobato, shekkevan shettaqqanat chakamim hi sheyyachazor sheliach tzibbur hattepilla lehotzi et sheeno baqi vehatztzibbur chayyabim lishtoq velishmoa kol beraka mippi hashsheliach tzibbur velaanot acharayv amen, im ken hare berakot ellu alehem choba leshoman mehashsheliach tzibbur ap al pi shehitpallel kebar. Abal achar birkot hattora shebbetzibbur yakol laanot ap al pi shello shama, shehabberakot lo letzorek hatztzibbur nitqena ella mippene shehaqqore betzibbur rauy lo lebarek. Veap shechoba al hatztzibbur leshoman kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"t, mikkol maqom iqqar birkato hi letzorek atzmo velo letzorek hatztzibbur kemo battepilla. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, lizzaher lishmoa birkot y"ch mippi hashsheliach tzibbur. Abal im lo haya yakol lishmoa, kegon shehaya mitpallel y"ch ukeshessiyyem tepillato siyyem sheliach tzibbur beraka achat — oneh acharayv im yodea ezeh beraka hi. Vaapillu lo siyyem tepillato ad sheharbeh min hatztzibbur anu kebar amen (veen inyan amen achar amen ella achar habberaka, vetzarik laanot miyyad shekkolta habberaka, veim lav hi amen yetoma, ap al pi ken) im lo kolta amen mippi rob hatztzibbur — oneh immahem (ap al pi sheyyesh shihuy ben gemar habberaka lehatchalat aniyyato), lepi shekkol shello kolta amen mippi rob haonim — adayin lo nishlam inyan habberaka legamre, sheaniyyat amen gam ken min habberaka hi, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"z. Abal leachar shekkolta amen mippi rob hatztzibbur, ap al pi shehammiut maarikim — en behaarakatam kelum, shehammaarik beamen yoter midday — eno ella toeh, veim ken nishlam kebar inyan habberaka legamre (vezeh shemmatchil atta laanot amen — amen yetoma hi, kevan sheyyesh shihuy harbeh ben gemar habberaka mippi hambarek lehatchalat aniyyato. Veap al pi sheamen shel hatztzibbur gam ken min habberaka hi — en lo laanot acharehem, sheen onin amen achar haonin amen ella achar hambarek. Abal im en shihuy ben gemar habberaka lehatchalat aniyyato — yakol laanot achar haonim amen, kegon sheshshama echad oneh amen achar ezo beraka vehu yodea ezo beraka hi — yakol laanot acharayv miyyad im zeh lo heerik kol kak, kemo shehatztzibbur maarikim umishtahim baaniyyatam mippene shei epshar sheyyetzamtzemu kullam lehatchil velipsoq berega echad). Veyesh mi sheomer sheapillu kolta amen mippi rob hatztzibbur (vaapillu siyyemu kullam) — yakol laanot amen acharehem venechshab keoneh achar habberaka (kevan shekkullam hitchilu miyyad achar habberaka), vehu sheyyaaneh acharehem miyyad [(]uleinyan maaseh — hakkol lepi inyan shihuy shemmiggemar birkat hambarek lesiyyum aniyyat haonim). Veken beqaddish uqedushsha u"bareku", kol shello siyyemu rob hatztzibbur — oneh immahem ap al pi shello (shameu kullam) [shama kelum] mippi hashsheliach tzibbur [(]velassebara haacharona apillu siyyemu rubban, kol shennisharu t' immo shehem asara im hashsheliach tzibbur, sheen dabar shebbiqdushsha pachot measara). Veap lehaomerim shekkol shehu mechuyyab bedabar eno yotze yede chobato baaniyya ad sheyyishma, mikkol maqom eno niqra mechuyyab baddabar leinyan zeh ella bedabar shemmechuyyab leomro ap beyachid, mah sheen ken beqaddish uqedushsha u"bareku":

Velo yaaneh amen qetzara, ella arukka qetzat, kede sheyyukal lomar "el melek neeman", ki zehu perusho shel amen vehem rashe tebot shellah. Velo yaarik bah yoter midday, lepi sheen qeriat hatteba nishmaat keshemmaarik yoter midday. Veim yesh qetzat mehaonim shemmaarikim yoter midday — en tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur o shear hambarek lehamtin alehem, im beraka shelleachareha hi beraka sheenah choba al hakkol lishmoa. Abal im motzi et harabbim yede chobatan — tzarik lehamtin ap al hattoim umaarikim beamen, kede sheyyishmeu veyetzeu yede chobatan gam hem:
Haoneh amen — lo yagbiah qolo yoter mehambarek, shenneemar: "gaddelu laHashem itti uneromema shemo yachdav":

Mi sheshshakach velo amar "yaaleh veyabo" berosh chodesh o bechullo shel moed veken bekol dabar shetztzarik lachazor bishbilo — yesh lo taqqana sheyyekavven dato veyishma mishsheliach tzibbur kol y"ch berakot merosh ad sop keadam shemmitpallel leatzmo velo yapsiq velo yasiach uposea g' pesiot leacharayv, shekkevan shekkebar hitpallel ella sheshshakach millehazkir — hashsheliach tzibbur motzio yede chobato ap al pi shehu baqi. Ak en kol adam yakol lekavven dato lishmoa mishsheliach tzibbur merosh vead sop (veshemma lebabo yipneh velo yishma mishsheliach tzibbur ezeh dabar hamakkeb battepilla[)], laken mutab lehitpallel beatzmo:
